# DTE Roofing

> Family-owned roofing contractor in Columbus, Ohio. Roof repair, roof replacement, storm and hail damage, gutters, siding, and commercial roofing across 13 Central Ohio communities. Founded in 2023 by brothers Donovan and Mitchell Davis, who grew up in Hilliard.

DTE Roofing LLC
615 Hilliard Rome Rd, Columbus, OH 43228
Phone (call or text): 614-971-6028
Email: experience@dteroofing.com

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM
- Sunday: closed
- Emergency roof repair: 24/7 by phone

## Service area
Columbus, Hilliard, Dublin, New Albany, Upper Arlington, Westerville, Gahanna, Reynoldsburg, Grove City, Pickerington, Worthington, Delaware, and Powell, Ohio.

- [All service areas](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/locations)

## Services
- [Roof repair](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/roof-repair): leaks, shingle replacement, flashing, storm damage
- [Roof replacement](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/roof-replacement): full tear-off; asphalt, architectural, and metal
- [New roof installation](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/roof-installation)
- [Free roof inspection](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/roof-inspection): pre-purchase, post-storm, and insurance reports with photos
- [Storm damage repair](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/storm-damage): hail and wind damage, insurance claim support, emergency tarping
- [24/7 emergency roofing](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/emergency-services)
- [Gutters](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/gutters): seamless gutters, gutter guards, downspouts
- [Siding](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/siding): vinyl, fiber cement, and composite
- [Preventative maintenance](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/preventative-maintenance)
- [Commercial roofing](https://www.dteroofingllc.com/services/commercial-roofing): TPO, EPDM, metal, and flat roofs
